algorithm.capacity_rule: A stratum whose quota exceeds its eligible count takes all eligible members and is fixed; the remaining slots are re-apportioned by the same largest-remainder rule over the unfixed strata, repeated until no quota exceeds capacity.
algorithm.description: anchor and ci: largest-remainder proportional allocation over exact raw (origin, task_type, difficulty) strata of the dev questions (ties: ascending stratum tuple, exact fractions); within a stratum ids ranked by ascending sha256(seed + NUL + id).hexdigest(); ids listed in training-file order.
algorithm.dev: no draw: every Q&A question of the training release's validation split that the exclusion rule keeps, in training-file order
algorithm.name: stratified-largest-remainder-sha256-v1

ci_note: The CI smoke subset is these 20 Tier-K dev questions plus 10 Tier-F dev tasks added after Phase 3.

dev_source.rule: dev = the release's validation Q&A questions that the exclusion rule keeps; the release's training files hold none of them (checked when the split is built and by ./gb audit)

exclusions.rule: dev candidates exclude every training question with at least one of these reasons

test_neighbours.definition: training questions linked by semantic, lexical or keep_both evidence (thresholds above) to a frozen test question they share no 8-gram with; flagged, not counted in eval plan §6

test_twins.definition: training questions sharing a word 8-gram with a frozen test question (eval plan §6)
test_twins.tokenizer: lowercase; every non-word character (regex \W) to a space; split on whitespace; n = 8

twin_groups.coverage_note: semantic_duplicate_candidates.jsonl scores only source-lane questions (floor 0.82); pairs with a blind-lane question are covered by the lexical TF-IDF check, 8-grams and adjudicated KEEP_BOTH decisions.
twin_groups.threshold_rule: lower edge of the lowest score band in which at least half of the training pairs Claude read (no shared 8-gram) were twins; checked against union-find chaining
